description:
Sign this session in to an A-Team tenant with an API key. A session must be signed in before any tenant-aware operation (reading solutions, deploying, testing, the widget catalog, the design advisor). The docs need no sign-in: ateam_bootstrap, ateam_get_spec, ateam_get_examples, ateam_get_workflows, ateam_spec_search, and validation.

AN AGENT DOES NOT ASK FOR A KEY. Ask the user to connect this MCP through the hosted connector: add https://mcp.ateam-ai.com as a remote MCP server (connector) in their client, and authorize it in the browser when it asks. The session is then signed in to the tenant and environment they chose, and no key passes through this chat. Then this tool is not needed.

This tool is for a local setup where the user supplies their own key. The key's adas_<env>_ prefix picks the environment (adas_prod_… → https://api.ateam-ai.com, adas_dev_… → https://dev-api.ateam-ai.com). An ADAS_API_KEY environment variable does NOT sign a session in: a key baked into a shared config could point work at the wrong tenant, so tenant tools refuse until the session signs in. For cross-tenant admin operations, use master_key instead of api_key.

api_key.description: The user's A-Team API key. The key's adas_<env>_ prefix picks the environment (adas_prod_… → https://api.ateam-ai.com, adas_dev_… → https://dev-api.ateam-ai.com).

master_key.description: Master key for cross-tenant operations. Authenticates across ALL tenants without per-tenant API keys. Requires tenant parameter.

tenant.description: Tenant name (e.g., dev, main). Optional with api_key if format is adas_<tenant>_<hex>. REQUIRED with master_key.

url.description: Only for a host that is neither A-Team environment (localhost, a self-hosted deployment), or for an older key that names no environment (adas_<tenant>_<hex>, which otherwise lands on this server's default API). Leave it out for an adas_<env>_ key: the key already picks its environment, and a url that contradicts it is refused.

name: ateam_auth
